description: Ellie Vincy makes press-on nails from a mold of your own fingers, so they fit the shape of your natural nails instead of a generic size chart. This app explains that process end to end: order the Custom Nail Starter Pack, take a mold of all ten fingers at home, mail it back with a prepaid USPS QR code that needs no printer or stamp, follow the status timeline as it reaches the studio, and artisans then hand-build every set on your mold. Once your mold is on file, reorders skip the molding step entirely. The app also searches the live ellievincynails.com catalog by style, shape, length or nail-care item and returns matching products with current prices, stock status and direct links, read from the Shopify Storefront API in real time. It is read-only, shows physical goods only, and links out to the storefront for checkout.

defaultPrompt: How do I get nails made from a mold of my own fingers?
Show me almond-shaped press-on nail sets
Walk me through the mold kit process step by step
